summary.healthyHint: {{mode}} · all nodes alive with a leader
summary.degradedHint: {{mode}} · one or more nodes need attention
summary.noLeaderHint: No frontend has been elected — metadata writes are blocked

node.journalLagHint: How far this frontend trails the leader's metadata journal. A replica that stops replaying cannot take over.

topology.quorumLost: Metadata quorum lost: only {{alive}} of {{total}} electable frontends are alive. Metadata writes are blocked until a majority returns.
topology.clusterIdMismatch: Frontends report different cluster ids — at least one node belongs to another cluster.

loads.loadError: Could not load routine load jobs
loads.staleNotice: Showing the last successful snapshot — the most recent refresh failed.
loads.empty: No routine load jobs found in any database. Create one with CREATE ROUTINE LOAD to stream data from Kafka or Pulsar.

table.lagTooltip: Approximate messages behind the source log end

alerts.empty: No alerts fired yet — quiet is good.
alerts.apiUnreachable: Could not reach the StarLens API.

alertSettings.title: Alert settings
alertSettings.description: Environment variables are the defaults; values saved here override them and apply immediately — no restart.
alertSettings.readOnly: Configuration is read-only: the server runs with ALERT_CONFIG_UI=false, so changes go through environment variables.
alertSettings.webhookConfigured: A webhook is configured ({{hint}}). Leave the field empty to keep it.
alertSettings.webhookNotConfigured: No webhook configured — alerts currently go to the server log only.
alertSettings.webhookWillBeRemoved: The webhook will be removed when you save.
alertSettings.zeroDisables: 0 disables a threshold rule. Durations use Go syntax: 30s, 5m, 1h.
alertSettings.resetDone: All overrides cleared — environment defaults are in effect.
alertSettings.saved: Saved. Changes apply on the next evaluation tick.
alertSettings.savedAndDelivered: Saved — the test alert reached every channel.

hints.starrocksUnavailable: Check that STARROCKS_DSN points at a reachable FE query port (9030) and that the user can run SHOW FRONTENDS.
hints.networkError: The StarLens API is not responding. Start it with `go run ./cmd/server` in backend/.
hints.timeout: Raise STARROCKS_QUERY_TIMEOUT if the cluster is under heavy load.
